fullDescription: A sophisticated institutional and archival design style characterized by a 'Modern Museum' aesthetic. It features a cream and deep green color palette with gold and crimson accents, utilizing a high-contrast pairing of editorial serif and clean sans-serif typography. Suitable for cultural heritage sites, high-end educational platforms, fintech, and digital archives. The layout emphasizes whitespace, ornamental dividers, and 'plaque-style' UI elements with subtle noise textures and floating animations.

structured.summary: An archival institutional landing page featuring a scholarly aesthetic with high-contrast serif headers, a cream background, and sophisticated green and gold accents. The design uses fixed navigation, noise-textured overlays, and timeline-based storytelling.

style.description: The style is 'Digital Curatorial'—combining academic tradition with modern interaction. Typography pairs 'Playfair Display' (headings/italics) with 'Outfit' (body/UI). Primary color is a deep forest green (#00604a) complemented by a rich cream (#fefdef), an accent gold (#d4af37), and a secondary crimson (#bd264a). Visuals use grayscale photography that transitions to color on hover. A subtle SVG noise overlay provides a tactile paper feel.
style.prompt: Create a design system using a cream background (#fefdef). Use 'Playfair Display' for headings (weights 400-900, with frequent use of italics for emphasis) and 'Outfit' for all UI and body text. Primary brand color: #00604a; Secondary: #bd264a; Accents: #d4af37; Surfaces: #eeedd9; Text: #2c2c2c. Implement a noise overlay using a fractal noise SVG filter at 0.08 opacity. Buttons should be sharp-cornered (rounded-sm) with 12px horizontal and 6px vertical padding for small versions, or 48px horizontal and 24px vertical for CTA versions. Use border-widths of 1px and 1.5px for ornamental elements. Animations: floating vertical movement (8s ease-in-out), smooth color transitions (300ms), and grayscale-to-color image transitions (700ms).

layout_and_structure.description: A structured, section-based layout with high-padding (py-32) that balances information density with generous whitespace. It transitions between light cream sections and high-contrast dark green sections.

prompts.prompt: Fixed top bar, 80px height, background #fefdef with a 10% opacity green bottom border. Left side: 32x32px green square logo with white serif 'C'. Center: Nav links in 14px uppercase Outfit, 40px spacing. Right side: Theme toggle switch (pill-shaped, 32x16px) and a solid green button (#00604a) with white text 'Sign In'.

70vh height. Background has a 5% opacity architectural watermark image. Centered text stack: Italicized gold label (#d4af37) in 14px uppercase, followed by an 80px-96px serif H1 where certain words are crimson (#bd264a) and italicized. Max-width 800px for the 24px light-weight lead paragraph.
Full width with 80px vertical padding. A single 1px horizontal line in 40% opacity gold. In the center, break the line with a gem icon (lucide:gem) flanked by two shorter 48px lines.

Two-column grid (1:1 ratio). Left column: 500x500px tan surface (#eeedd9) container featuring 'Plaque Corners' (16x16px gold L-shapes in each corner). Inside, a grayscale image. An overlapping 192x192px box at the bottom-right corner displays a serif quote. Right column: 48px serif heading, 18px body text, and a stats row with 36px crimson numbers and 12px uppercase green labels.

Background #eeedd9. A vertical 1px line (#00604a/20%) runs down the center. Content alternates left/right. Each milestone has a 16x16px gold-bordered dot with a center gold circle. Headings use 32px serif italics for the year and 18px bold uppercase for the title.

Background #002f24 (Deep Green), text #fefdef. Left column: 48px serif heading. Numbered list (01, 02, 03) where numbers are 30px gold serif at 40% opacity. Right column: Large circular frame with 10% opacity border containing a floating animated artifact icon/image.

Background #eeedd9. 4-column layout. Column 1 (span 2): Logo and mission text. Columns 3 & 4: Link lists with 12px uppercase green headers. Bottom bar: 1px border-top, displaying copyright in 10px 0.2em tracked uppercase text and institutional location markers (London, New York, Tokyo).

special_ui_components.description: An archival-style image frame with ornate corner details.
special_ui_components.prompt: Create a square container with background #eeedd9. Position four absolute-positioned divs (16x16px) in each corner. Each div has a 1.5px border in #d4af37 (top-left has border-t and border-l, etc.). Center a grayscale image inside with 48px of padding.

special_ui_components.description: A high-contrast button with a slide-up hover effect.
special_ui_components.prompt: Primary button: 48px height, background #00604a, text #fefdef, 14px bold uppercase tracking-widest. On hover, translate a darker green (#004d3b) background layer from bottom-to-top (translate-y-full to translate-y-0) and shift the whole button -4px on the Y-axis.

special_ui_components.description: A subtle vertical floating animation for featured icons or images.
special_ui_components.prompt: Apply a keyframe animation 'float' to an element: 0% and 100% { transform: translateY(0px); } 50% { transform: translateY(-15px); }. Duration: 8 seconds, timing-function: ease-in-out.
